function.name: schedule_meeting
function.description: Creates the Microsoft 365 event and sends attendee invitations ONLY after the caller confirms the final title, attendees, date, time and duration. First run check_meeting_availability and read back the selected free slot. Use its exact date, startTime and confirmationToken. An initial request to schedule a meeting starts Tool 1, not this tool. Retry an uncertain creation with the identical arguments and call ID. New meetings request a Microsoft Teams link. Use event.joinUrl when returned; never invent a link, meeting ID, or passcode. If meetingLinkStatus is unavailable, report that the event exists but its Teams link was not returned. Include location only when supplied by the caller.

title.description: Exact meeting title confirmed and checked by Tool 1.

attendeeEmails.description: Comma-separated confirmed directory emails returned by Tool 1. Do not include the organizer.

date.description: Absolute YYYY-MM-DD date of the selected slot returned by Tool 1. Do not send a relative date here.

duration.description: Confirmed duration, for example 30 minutes. Must match Tool 1.

timeZone.description: Use the selected slot's timeZone, normally America/New_York.

confirmed.description: Set to true only after the caller explicitly confirms the final meeting details.

confirmationToken.description: Copy the confirmationToken from the selected free requestedSlot or alternative in Tool 1. Valid for 15 minutes. Do not modify or read it aloud.

description.description: Optional plain-text agenda or description, only when provided or requested by the caller. Do not invent it. Tool 2 must copy the exact description checked by Tool 1; recheck if it changes.

location.description: Optional physical meeting location or room, only when supplied by the caller. Copy the exact location from Tool 1 into Tool 2. This label does not reserve a room.
